annual_eligible_discharges_source: Illustrative cohort only; not CHHHS activity data

delayed_discharge_ge12h_rate.source: ANZICS 2024/25 Critical Care Resources and Activity Report: pooled all-age rate for >=12h discharge delay; 162 ICUs; not a Cairns estimate

delayed_cases_addressable_fraction.source: Illustrative fraction addressable by liaison, not locally observed

addressable_cases_improved_fraction.source: Illustrative proportion improved after coverage and effect, not measured

hours_released_per_improved_case.source: Illustrative index discharge-ready hours removed per improved case

unplanned_72h_readmission_risk.source: Illustrative 72h unplanned return risk per live eligible ICU-ward discharge; NOT ANZICS CCR/APD readmission

relative_readmission_reduction.source: Unproven intervention effect; negative values allow appropriate return escalation

additional_cost_per_readmission_aud.source: Illustrative incremental postdischarge return-episode cost net of otherwise expected ward care

net_avoidable_cost_per_icu_day_aud.source: Illustrative avoidable cost for INDEX ready-to-discharge ICU day net of ward costs, NOT average ICU bed cost

annual_incremental_service_cost_aud.source: Illustrative annual fully-loaded cost of liaison, NOT a CHHHS workforce quote
